We’re still in “repair + rebuild” mode, not “infinite corpus” mode.

One canonical atoms file is easier to point CRF/SAE/SandCrawler at and debug.

We can always shard later (Math/Reading/Writing/Motivation) once it grows.

So I’m going to assume ONE and give you a concrete, LLM-built atoms batch targeted to:
